movie.title: Everyone Is Lying to You for Money
movie.originalTitle: Everyone Is Lying to You for Money
movie.overview: With any and all things crypto being pushed by celebrities, influencers, and politicians alike, actor-turned-author and director Ben McKenzie decides to investigate. Leveraging his celebrity status to gain access to eager prospectors, McKenzie finds himself unraveling the loosely regulated world of cryptocurrency. This skeptical but evenhanded take on the present and future of what we consider money gives a firsthand account of the chaotic financial frontier of our time.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In a quest to uncover the truth behind the cryptocurrency craze, actor Ben McKenzie dives into the chaotic, loosely regulated financial frontier to expose the deception fueled by celebrities and influencers.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Driven by the overwhelming promotion of cryptocurrency by celebrities and politicians, actor and director Ben McKenzie sets out to uncover the truth behind the hype. By using his own fame to infiltrate the inner circles of eager crypto prospectors, he discovers a volatile, loosely regulated financial landscape. This documentary offers a skeptical yet balanced exploration of modern money, revealing the precarious reality behind the glittering promises of digital wealth.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: As cryptocurrency continues to dominate headlines with endorsements from high-profile celebrities and politicians, actor-turned-director Ben McKenzie grows increasingly skeptical of the industry's promises. Deciding to investigate the phenomenon firsthand, he leverages his own celebrity status to gain unprecedented access to the major players and eager prospectors driving the crypto boom. McKenzie embarks on a global journey, peeling back the layers of a loosely regulated and often chaotic financial frontier. Along the way, he encounters both true believers and outright scam artists, revealing the alarming risks hidden beneath the industry's shiny veneer. Through critical analysis and candid interviews, he exposes the systemic deception used to siphon money from everyday investors. The film balances this inherent skepticism with an evenhanded look at the evolution of modern currency and the psychology of financial bubbles. Ultimately, McKenzie paints a stark, cautionary portrait of the present and future of money. He leaves viewers with a firsthand account of the chaotic financial landscape of our time, warning against the dangers of unchecked financial innovation.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: "Everyone Is Lying to You for Money" is a compelling documentary that delves deep into the heart of the modern cryptocurrency explosion. Prompted by the aggressive pushing of digital assets by influencers, politicians, and fellow celebrities, actor and director Ben McKenzie steps behind the camera to investigate the reality of this modern gold rush. Utilizing his Hollywood status to bypass traditional barriers, McKenzie infiltrates the inner workings of the crypto world, securing candid interviews with eager prospectors, industry titans, and financial regulators. What he uncovers is a dangerously under-regulated financial frontier, rife with speculation, deception, and systemic risks. The film provides a skeptical yet balanced examination of what society currently considers money, blending personal narrative with rigorous investigative journalism. It offers audiences a firsthand, eye-opening account of the chaotic landscape of digital currency, challenging viewers to question the motives of those selling the future of finance.

story_structure.climax: The investigation reaches its peak as the crypto ecosystem experiences major market turbulence and high-profile collapses, exposing the full extent of the risks and deceptions McKenzie set out to analyze.
story_structure.conflict: Skepticism collides with widespread mania as McKenzie seeks to determine whether crypto represents a revolutionary financial future or a massive, loosely regulated speculative bubble.
story_structure.resolution: McKenzie synthesizes his firsthand observations into an evenhanded assessment of modern finance, providing a cautionary perspective on speculative frontiers, celebrity-driven hype, and the nature of trust in digital money.
story_structure.introduction: Actor Ben McKenzie leverages his unique insider-outsider status to step into the world of cryptocurrency during a peak era of aggressive celebrity endorsements and hype.
story_structure.risingAction: McKenzie conducts interviews with key industry figures, influencers, and regulators, pulling back the curtain on aggressive marketing tactics, opaque financial instruments, and systemic vulnerabilities.
